title: Kavrix crowd event (schema_version 1)
description: One JSON object per event, produced by crowd_risk.py. Two types: crowd_risk (one reading, about once per second) and crowd_alert (a reading that needs an officer, with an extra alert_kind and message). Extra fields are allowed and must be preserved. Events form a hash chain per run_id: event_hash = SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the event without event_hash (see ai/crowd/README.md). Do not change any value when storing or forwarding an event, or the hash no longer matches.

run_id.description: One recording or live stream. The hash chain restarts at an all-zero prev_hash for every run_id.

drone_id.description: The drone that filmed it, for example D-01.

seq.description: 0, 1, 2, ... within a run_id, with no gaps. A gap means a lost event.

risk.description: Crowd-crush risk score. Relative to the people detected, not an absolute danger measure.

level.description: LOW below 35, MEDIUM 35 to below 65, HIGH 65 and above.

count.description: People detected (about 89% of the true crowd on average; see the accuracy results).

density_peak.description: People within one local window at the densest spot.

motion.description: Crowd movement after the drone's own motion is removed.

risk_rate.description: Risk points per second over the last 2 s (positive = rising).

time_to_high.description: Estimated seconds until HIGH if the rise continues. An estimate, or null.

hotspot.description: Densest spot as fractions of the video frame (x from the left, y from the top). A frame position, not a map coordinate; the map pin uses lat/lng.

timestamp.description: Wall-clock time the event was produced (UTC, ISO 8601).

heatmap.description: Relative path of the annotated snapshot image, for example heatmaps/event_0003.jpg.

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the snapshot image file.

prev_hash.description: event_hash of the previous event in this run, or 64 zeros for seq 0.

event_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this event without event_hash.

message.description: crowd_alert only: a sentence for the officer.
